links.evidence: We outsource the manufacturing of our products to two key manufacturing partners, Flextronics International Ltd. and Phoenix Contact GmbH & Co. KG.
We outsource the manufacturing of our products to two key manufacturing partners, Flextronics International Ltd. and Phoenix Contact GmbH & Co. KG.
In Q3 2023, we announced that a large AI supercomputer would be built entirely on Intel Xeon processors and 4,000 Intel Gaudi 2 AI hardware accelerators, with Stability AI as the anchor customer.
In December 2017 we entered into a new collaboration agreement with Ionis Pharmaceuticals Inc. (Ionis) to identify new antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) drug candidates for the treatment of SMA.
Samsung Electronics, Co., Ltd. (Samsung), accounted for approximately 7% , 14% and 25% of our total revenue in fiscal years 2016 , 2015 and 2014 , respectively.
As of December 31, 2023, a customer of our Semiconductor Test segment, Texas Instruments Inc, accounted for 18% of our accounts receivable balance.
In 2012, Hewlett-Packard Company accounted for 18% of our net revenue (19% in 2011 and 21% in 2010)
